ja353:1.1: Na-y-idaṃ niccaṃ bhavitabbaṃ Brahmadatta khemaṃ subhikkhaṃ suhatā va kāye, atthaccaye mā hu sammūḷho bhinnaplavo sāgarasseva majjhe.
ja353:2.1: Yāni karoti puriso tāni attani passati (Cfrṣupra vol.II p..) kalyāṇakāri kalyāṇaṃ pāpakāri ca pāpakaṃ, yādisaṃ vapate bījaṃ tādisaṃ harate phalan
ja353:3.1: ti. Idaṃ tad ācariyavaco Pārāsariyo yad abravi: (Cfrṣupra vol.II. p..) māssu tvaṃ akarā pāpaṃ yaṃ taṃ pacchā kataṃ tape.
ja353:4.1: Ayam eva so Piṅgiya dhonasākho yahiṃ ghātayiṃ khattiyānaṃ sahassaṃ alaṃkate candanasāralitte, tam eva dukkhaṃ paccāgataṃ mamā ti.
ja353:5.1: Sāmā ca kho candanalittagattī laṭṭhīva sobhañjanakassa uggatā, adisvā kālaṃ karissāmi Ubbariṃ, taṃ me tato dukkhataraṃ bhavissatīti
